name: template
body: A project template: name (directory name, unique across slide and section templates), kind (slide|section — determined solely by its directory, the resolved library's `slides/` or `sections/`), description, fields, sections (accepted section templates + min/max), body rule — declared in `template.yaml` — plus a standard Go html/template layout (receives pre-rendered safe HTML and typed values; only the centrally defined helper set — v1: `media`, `section`, `dict`, `list`) and example slide. A layout may invoke a section template directly with the `section` helper, as if the instance were authored in Markdown (section-helper). A section template may declare child sections with the same `sections:` schema, so composition nests; composition depth is bounded at six heading levels (requirements.constraint.section-depth-limit). Aggregate root of templating; belongs to the template library.
